name: integration-card
purpose: Use IntegrationCard for one tile of a catalog of integrations, extensions or plugins; for a bordered box of related content use Card, and for a collection of resource records shown as cards use CardList. A catalog tile laid out from props: a logo mark, the item name, its vendor, a short description, badges, the installed state and one action. The name is the tile's single target: a link when `href` is set, otherwise a button that emits `select`, stretched over the whole tile. `featured` gives the centred, raised layout used for a short row of picks above the full catalog. It was the `integration` variant of `Card` until 6.0, split out because a tile shares neither the header nor the footer of a content card.
useWhen: A catalog tile for an integration, an extension or a plugin: the logo, the name, the vendor, a short description, badges, the installed state and one action.
A short row of highlighted integrations above the full catalog (Featured): add `featured` for the centred, raised layout with the badges in the corner.
A starter template or next-step tile that carries a mark, a name and a short description and links somewhere.
avoidWhen: A bordered box of related content with a title, a body and a footer → use `card`.
One record of a resource list shown as cards, with selection and fields → use `card-list` (with `useCollection`).
One tier of a pricing comparison → use `pricing-card`.
A single row of title, description, media and actions → use `item`.
related: `card` — the content box this tile was split from; shares its surface tokens.
`tag` — renders the badges and the Installed state.
`card-list` — the resource list in card form, with selection.
`view/view-marketplace` — the block that lays these tiles out in a filtered grid.
bestPractices: The tile is laid out from props: `title`, `logo` (or the `logo` slot), `vendor`, `description`, `badges` and `installed`. The title becomes a link when `href` is set, otherwise a button that emits `select`, and it stretches over the whole tile so the tile is one target. Put a single action (Install, Configure) in the `actions` slot; it sits above the stretched target and stays reachable on its own.
Keep the description to one or two sentences; the tile clamps it to three lines.
Show at most two badges (category, context, plan). The installed state is a prop, not a badge, so it reads the same everywhere.
Tiles sit under a section heading, so their title is an `h3`.

`featured` centres the mark, the name, the vendor and the description on a raised surface with a primary glow at the top, and moves the badges to the top end corner, and a badge without `severity` or `variant` stays `info`, as on the plain tile. Use it for a row of at most three or four picks above the full catalog, never for every tile; the full catalog keeps the plain tile.

props.name: title
props.doc: The item name; the tile's single target.

props.name: logo
props.doc: Icon class for the logo mark. The `logo` slot takes an image instead.

props.name: vendor
props.doc: Who publishes the item, shown as "by {vendor}".

props.name: description
props.doc: One or two sentences on what the item does.

props.name: badges
props.doc: Small tags such as the category or the context (`{ label, variant?, severity? }`, `variant` a `TagVariant` and `severity` a `TagSeverity` (`IntegrationCardBadgeVariant` and `IntegrationCardBadgeSeverity`); a badge with neither is `info`, in the plain and the featured layout).

props.name: href
props.doc: The title links here; without it the title is a button that emits `select`.

props.name: featured
props.doc: The featured layout, centred on a raised surface with a primary glow at the top and the badges in the top end corner.

events.name: select
events.notes: Without `href`: the title (the whole tile) was activated.

slots.name: logo
slots.notes: Replaces the logo mark, for an `img` with an empty `alt`.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: One action at the end of the tile, above the stretched title target.
